node.title: XR deficient Padé family: active-defect payment and punctured-list router
node.statement: In a nonempty deficient primitive Pade family (f_tau,g_tau)=(f_*+Q tau,g_*-P tau), the residual rho=P(u-f_*)+Q(v-g_*) is invariant across tau and has support D contained in the whole-kernel forced set G_d, with e=|D|<=d-ell-1. No joint core meets D. On H\D there is a fixed word w with E_tau=Q(w-tau), E_tau'=-P(w-tau), so the family injects into the exact punctured RS list of degree-<k-ell polynomials agreeing with w on k+d points. Every projective scalar error factors as (alpha Q-beta P)(w-tau). A D-local selected ray has an (h-d)-point block in D and every outside root of its degree-ell factor already in the core; distinct selected blocks are disjoint. All pairs exposing a selected off-core point outside D cost at most n-e, so only the D-local family remains, necessarily e>=2(h-d).
